ops.title: Inventory SDK producer jobs and artifacts before release scheduling decisions
ops.description: Confirmed scheduler reporting bug: SDK24 outer workflow status remained queued while verify, sdist and LinuxARM producer jobs had succeeded; coarse outer-status polling missed real material work. SDK24 later cancelled under shared-account annotation; exact acting thread and trigger UNKNOWN, not proven automatic pending replacement. SDK25 had a fresh only-unassigned verify job/artifacts0/public404 and was explicitly Root-approved cancelled once to coalesce SDK26. Preserve immutable24/25 tags and partial24 artifacts. Owner /root/ccx_related_topk_ship. Next executable step: retain normalized run+ALL actual job/runner/conclusion/artifact/public inventory at producer milestones and before any tag/cancel, then assess documented GitHub queue:max separately only when actual queue-loss mechanism is established. Root defers queue workflow changes while ready delivery installs.

ops.text: Exact counterexample and cancellation actor uncertainty retained in canonical receipts; material producer work never inferred from outer queued status
